Hot Dog Pizza
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:09am

Ingredients




1 pkt Crescent rolls
1/4 cup Parmesan cheese
1 can Pizza sauce
2 Hot dogs, sliced
Mozzarella cheese, shredded
Cheddar cheese, shredded

Preparation

1 Unroll crescent rolls. Divide along short perforations to form 4 rectangles. Pat perforations together to seal seam. Place rectangles on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over rolls. Top with pizza sauce. Top with hot dogs and the rest of the cheese. 2 Bake for 6 to 7 minutes or until heated through.
